text:
olivia: Heads-up — Sirius private/VPC deploy tomorrow 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (window 02:00-04:00). I’ll be primary deploy lead. Need final smoke checklist, rollback steps, and CR approvals. tagging: @sam_k @diego @maria_g @jules.

sam_k: I can run smoke tests and own post-deploy monitoring. Will run quick preflight locally and share commands.

sam_k: Smoke test I’ll use:
```bash
./smoke.sh --env=sirius-vpc --target=api --timeout=120
# expectations: 200s, p95 < 150ms, token-errors 0
```

diego: I’ll be oncall for the window. Rollback criteria proposal: errors > 5% or p95 > 500ms sustained for 3 consecutive 5-min windows -> immediate rollback. Need a canary and two probe endpoints (login, /v1/generate). Also check DB migration is reversible.

maria_g: Migration is small (add index on user_sessions). We'll run it in a transactional, online manner. Rollback is: restore previous index state (script at /ops/migrations/sirius/rollback_20260318.sql). Suggest toggling feature flag before schema change.

jules: CR status: code is green, tests passed. I requested +1 from eng-prs for the migration chunk. Can we schedule migration at 02:05 after canary?

olivia: Yes to 02:05 migration. Plan: canary at ~02:10 with ~5% traffic. If canary is healthy -> migrate -> full rollout.

sam_k: Canary smoke command:
```bash
k6 run canary.js -d 60s -u 20
```
I’ll post the canary metrics (p95/p50/errors) in thread.

infra-bot: preflight check result: certs OK, cluster nodes ready 5/6 (warning: node-7 disk 78%). Preflight URL: https://infra.redwood/sirius/preflight/2115 :eyes:

diego: @infra-bot noted. I’ll cordon node-7 before the window to avoid scheduling new pods. SRE, pls monitor disk during canary.

maria_g: Confirmed migration script path and rollback script present. Rollback SQL at /ops/migrations/sirius/rollback_20260318.sql. I'll add a short README with steps.

sam_k: Full plan checklist:
- Preflight (infra-bot) OK
- Canary (02:10) -> smoke
- Migrate (02:05) -> wait for replication lag < 1s
- Rollout (incremental) -> monitor 30m
- Post-rollout smoke -> close window

olivia: Rollback command if we need to revert the K8s deployment:
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/sirius-api -n prod --to-revision=20260317-3
```

jules: I’ll be on standby for quick PR revert and feature-flag toggle. Pinging @security for the flag override window.

maria_g: Quick Q: do we notify the customer? ops-team said yes, 1h prior.

olivia: I’ll send customer comms at 01:00 UTC and post in #customer-success.

sam_k: Confirming deploy team for the window: olivia (lead), sam_k (smoke/metrics), diego (oncall), maria_g (migration), jules (PR/rollback), infra-bot (preflight). :thumbsup:

diego: I’ll post the cordon link and live status here when I cordon node-7 (~01:45 UTC).

infra-bot: next automated pre-deploy run scheduled at 2115003600 (est).

olivia: Thanks all — short call at 01:50 UTC if anyone wants a last-minute runthrough. Otherwise we proceed async. :raised_hands:
